exposure: 2 units of oxytocin bolus followed by 5 units/hour infusion
5 units of oxytocin bolus followed by 5 units/hour infusion
cohort: 70 healthy adult women undergoing elective caesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Two units of oxytocin bolus followed by an infusion of 5 units per hour has a favorable efficacy and safety profile in healthy adult women undergoing elective caesarean delivery.
